1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Offline DNS model-based regression workbench.
     3	
     4	Reads one UTF-8 JSON document on stdin, validates it against the frozen
     5	contract, executes the local resolution model for every query/profile pair,
     6	adjudicates the supplied observations and computes an exact minimum-cost
     7	diagnostic basis.  Emits one JSON document on stdout and exits 0.
     8	"""
     9	
    10	import ipaddress
    11	import json
    12	import re
    13	import sys
    14	
    15	ERROR_JSON = '{"error":"invalid-input"}'
    16	
    17	MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024
    18	MAX_DEPTH = 32
    19	
    20	MAX_ZONES = 16
    21	MAX_ZONE_RECORD_ENTRIES = 1024
    22	MAX_RRSET_DISTINCT = 64
    23	MAX_PROFILES = 8
    24	MIN_PROFILES = 1
    25	MAX_QUERIES = 20
    26	MAX_OBSERVATIONS = 64
    27	MAX_OBSERVED_ANSWER = 128
    28	MAX_ALIASES = 64
    29	MAX_COST = 1000
    30	MAX_TXT_CHARS = 256
    31	MAX_LABEL_LEN = 63
    32	MAX_WIRE_LEN = 255
    33	MAX_ID_LEN = 32
    34	
    35	TYPES = ('A', 'AAAA', 'TXT', 'CNAME')
    36	RCODES = ('NOERROR', 'NXDOMAIN', 'SERVFAIL', 'REFUSED')
    37	CNAME_MODES = ('follow', 'stop')
    38	WILDCARD_MODES = ('rfc', 'off', 'one-label')
    39	
    40	ID_RE = re.compile(r'\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}\Z')
    41	LABEL_RE = re.compile(r'\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,63}\Z')
    42	A_RE = re.compile(r'\A(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})(?:\.(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})){3}\Z')
    43	
    44	
    45	class Invalid(Exception):
    46	    """Raised for any contract violation in the input document."""
    47	
    48	
    49	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    50	# small structural helpers
    51	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    52	
    53	def need(cond):
    54	    if not cond:
    55	        raise Invalid()
    56	
    57	
    58	def as_dict(value):
    59	    need(isinstance(value, dict))
    60	    return value
    61	
    62	
    63	def as_list(value):
    64	    need(isinstance(value, list))
    65	    return value
    66	
    67	
    68	def as_str(value):
    69	    need(isinstance(value, str))
    70	    return value
    71	
    72	
    73	def as_int(value):
    74	    need(isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool))
    75	    return value
    76	
    77	
    78	def exact_keys(obj, keys):
    79	    need(isinstance(obj, dict))
    80	    need(len(obj) == len(keys))
    81	    for key in keys:
    82	        need(key in obj)
    83	    return obj
    84	
    85	
    86	def check_id(value):
    87	    text = as_str(value)
    88	    need(len(text) <= MAX_ID_LEN)
    89	    need(ID_RE.match(text) is not None)
    90	    return text
    91	
    92	
    93	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94	# names and record data
    95	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    96	
    97	def check_name(value):
    98	    """Validate an absolute ASCII domain name; return its canonical form."""
    99	    text = as_str(value)
   100	    if text == '.':
   101	        return '.'
   102	    need(text.endswith('.'))
   103	    body = text[:-1]
   104	    need(body != '')
   105	    wire = 1
   106	    for label in body.split('.'):
   107	        if label == '*':
   108	            wire += 2
   109	        else:
   110	            need(LABEL_RE.match(label) is not None)
   111	            wire += 1 + len(label)
   112	        need(wire <= MAX_WIRE_LEN)
   113	    return text.lower()
   114	
   115	
   116	def label_count(name):
   117	    if name == '.':
   118	        return 0
   119	    return name.count('.')
   120
